descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Nebula' 'Nebula' Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Nebula' is a brand new selection of reticulated Japanese maple with an extraordinary reticulated variegation to the leaves. This ghost-like Japanese maple has pink new growth that radiates with lime green, while also displaying the veins of the leaf in a very prominent way. The foliage turns to bright green with darker veins. Fall color is a bright red to maroon red. 'Nebula' is a brand new selection by our friends at Buchholz Nursery. 'Nebula' is expected to reach 8 ft in 10 years. Give 'Nebula' protection from the hot afternoon sun for best colors. Photo of spring color, fall color, and full-size tree used with permission from Talon Buchholz.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Nebula'，‘Nebula’ 网脉斑锦日本枫，适生区 5-9。 ‘Nebula’ 是一个全新的网脉斑锦日本枫品种，叶片具有极其出众的网脉斑纹表现。 这一如幽灵般的日本枫，新梢呈粉色并泛出青柠绿色光泽，同时叶脉表现也非常醒目。 随后叶色转为鲜绿色，配以较深的叶脉。 秋季叶色为鲜红至栗红色。 ‘Nebula’ 是 Buchholz Nursery 推出的全新品种，预计 10 年可长至 8 英尺。 为获得最佳叶色，建议避开炎热的午后强光。 春色、秋色及成年树照片经 Talon Buchholz 授权使用。 带有 MrMaple 标识的照片
